title: The Biggest Flower in the Forest
subtitle: A flower that can't make its own food

pages.zh:
今天，我要去森林里找一朵花。
听说那是世界上最大的花。
pages.scene: walking into a misty green rainforest at morning, small backpack on his back, looking ahead with curiosity, tall trees and ferns, sunbeams through leaves
pages.en:
Today I'm going into the forest to find a flower.
They say it's the biggest flower in the world.

pages.zh:
森林里好安静。
树很高，叶子很大，比我的脸还大。
pages.scene: standing among giant elephant ear leaves taller than himself, looking up in wonder, deep green rainforest, dappled light
pages.en:
The forest is very quiet.
The trees are tall, and the leaves are big—
bigger than my face.

pages.zh:
咦？树上爬着一根粗粗的藤。
它一圈一圈，缠着大树往上爬。
pages.scene: touching a thick brown woody vine coiling up a huge tree trunk, looking closely, curious expression, rainforest understory
pages.en:
Huh? A thick vine is climbing up a tree.
Round and round, it wraps around the trunk and climbs.

pages.zh:
藤上鼓起一个圆圆的包，
像一颗大大的包菜。
pages.scene: crouching down next to a large round reddish brown flower bud the size of a cabbage growing directly on the vine on the forest floor, pointing at it, amazed
pages.en:
A round bump is swelling up on the vine,
like a great big cabbage.

pages.zh:
我等呀等。
包菜慢慢裂开了……
pages.scene: sitting patiently on a mossy log watching the big bud slowly cracking open, hands on knees, waiting, soft forest light
pages.en:
I wait and wait.
Slowly, the cabbage starts to open…

pages.zh:
哇——好大的一朵花！
五片厚厚的花瓣，红红的，长满白点点。
pages.scene: standing with arms spread wide in front of an enormous red flower with five thick petals covered in white speckles, as wide as he is tall, mouth open in amazement
pages.en:
Wow—what a huge flower!
Five thick petals, bright red,
covered in white spots.

pages.zh:
可是……好臭呀！
苍蝇嗡嗡嗡地飞过来了。
pages.scene: pinching his nose with one hand, leaning away from the giant red flower, small flies buzzing around it, funny disgusted face
pages.en:
But… it's so stinky!
The flies come buzzing over.

pages.zh:
奇怪，这朵花的叶子呢？
它的根呢？我怎么找不到？
pages.scene: kneeling and searching around the base of the giant flower with a puzzled face, hands on the ground, looking for roots, only the vine is there
pages.en:
That's strange. Where are this flower's leaves?
Where are its roots? I can't find them.

pages.zh:
原来它没有叶子，也没有根。
它住在藤的身体里，喝藤的水，吃藤的饭。
这叫「寄生」。
pages.scene: sitting cross legged next to the giant flower and the thick vine, listening and thinking, gentle cutaway view of the vine behind him, warm afternoon light
pages.en:
It turns out it has no leaves and no roots.
It lives inside the vine,
drinking the vine's water and eating the vine's food.
That's called being a “parasite.”

pages.zh:
别的花自己晒太阳做饭，
它却借住在别人家里。
森林里，每个人都有自己活下去的办法。
pages.scene: walking home along a forest path at golden sunset, looking back over his shoulder at the distant giant red flower, warm orange light, peaceful
pages.en:
Other flowers soak up the sun and make their own food,
but this one lives in someone else's home.
In the forest, everyone has their own way to stay alive.
